|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Imperial Stormtrooper (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-07-Imperial_Stormtrooper-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Imperial Stormtrooper (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Imperial Stormtrooper (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Clone. Blaster Rifle deploys (and fires) for free on this trooper. When this trooper fires Blaster Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take the other into hand). Immune to Rebel Barrier.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “(may take the other into hand)” to “(may take other into hand)”. PC-E1 text: “Clone. Blaster Rifle deploys (and fires) for free on this trooper. When this trooper fires Blaster Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take other into hand). Immune to Rebel Barrier.”<ref name="cl-1240_9">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
